title: [Known Issue] Expanding Server List with Screen Readers
body:
As of May 28th, 2020, it has come to our attention that Screen Readers on Discord are no longer able to expand the Server List with the “Enter” key.

Unfortunately, this has caused issues for accessing servers further up or down on the list (with the function currently only interacting with the link for the server).

Due to an update made by NVDA (introduced in NVDA 2020.1) which affected our tree view for the Server List, this particular behavior of the special function tied to the "Enter" key was removed.

This means the "Enter" key no longer functions as a switch into “Focus Mode” when looking at a tree view.

The key has now defaulted to the common key bind for interacting with the tree list: “insert+spacebar”.

If you are curious about NVDA or their changes, you can learn more about the open source screen reader technology here: https://www.nvaccess.org/

We hope this helps but if you're still running into issues accessing the Server List while using a screen reader, please reach out to our support team at dis.gd/contact.
